neon-glow.$description: Neon Glow — Key brand accent, active state indicators, data visualizations — injects a vibrant, code-like energy.

neon-muted.$description: Neon Muted — Subtle background tones in visualizations, less prominent brand elements.

scanline-fade.$description: Scanline Fade — Special effect for highlighting code or UI elements, mimicking a terminal scanline.

system-warning.$description: System Warning — Used sparingly for icons or highlights requiring urgent attention.

whiteout.$description: Whiteout — Primary text, primary CTA button backgrounds, icons.

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary text, descriptive copy, inactive navigation links.

pewter.$description: Pewter — Tertiary text, metadata, placeholder text.

cloud.$description: Cloud — Hover states on dark elements, subtle highlights.

graphite-light.$description: Graphite Light — Borders, dividers, subtle UI structure.

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary surfaces floating on the background.

graphite-deep.$description: Graphite Deep — Card backgrounds, code block surfaces.

depth.$description: Depth — The darkest surface color before pure black, for subtle elevation.

inter.$description: Headlines and primary marketing copy. Its clean, neutral geometry provides high readability, contrasting with the more stylized monospaced font.

geistmono.$description: Code snippets, UI labels, and data displays. Its monospaced form adds a technical, typewriter-like precision, reinforcing the developer-centric identity.
